name: native_compaction_prune_pre_checkpoint_items
notes: Checkpoint pruning / retention-budget walk (native_compaction.c vs LIVE agent/native_compaction.py). KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented; inputs restricted around them): (1) C port has NO summary retention — LIVE retains canonical compaction summaries via _is_summary_item within a separate summary budget; no summary items are exercised. (2) On budget exhaustion C BREAKS the retention walk while LIVE CONTINUES scanning; inputs exhaust the budget only at the final pre item or never. (3) C token-costs the JSON-serialized content string (+2 quote chars) vs LIVE's raw text; all content strings have len % 4 in {0, 1} so both estimates agree. (4) Whitespace-only contents excluded (LIVE treats as unmeasurable, C as text). The multipart input (last) exercises the array-content path where C joins input_text parts.
